prediction.risk_explanation: The model estimates a low risk of leaving. No urgent action is indicated.

recommended_actions: Schedule an early-life check-in; newer customers leave more often in this data.

model.name: Gradient Boosting
model.selection_rule: Highest 5-fold CV ROC-AUC on the development split.
model.threshold_rule: Maximises F1 on out-of-fold predictions of the development split.

interpretation: The predicted outcome compares the estimated probability with the decision threshold.
Risk bands: Low below 40%, Moderate from 40% to below 70%, High from 70%.
Key factors list the inputs that moved this customer's estimate the most.
limitations: The model was trained on one public telecom dataset (IBM Telco Customer Churn). Results may not transfer to other businesses, regions or time periods.
The model does not see support history, usage, contract dates or competitor offers, which often matter for churn.
Key factors show patterns the model associates with churn. They are not proven causes.
Probabilities are estimates. Compare customers with each other rather than reading any single score as an exact frequency.
disclaimer: This report is generated by a statistical model trained on a public telecom dataset. The churn probability is an estimate of how similar customers behaved in that data. It is not a guarantee of what this customer will do, and it does not prove why they would leave. Use it together with your own knowledge of the customer.
